mission: From a stock Pokemon FireRed Rev 1 new game, reach the native Hall of Fame without human controller input.

controlModes.handoff: fresh atomic observation before bot policy resumes

decisionLoop: request one atomic frame-boundary observation from the autonomous emulator worker
fan the immutable observation out to pure advisors
rectify conflicts using mission progress, safety, legality, confidence, and evidence
submit one bounded edge or semantically leased locomotion chord without advancing the emulator
observe its first stop condition and verify the postcondition

emulatorRuntime.speedSemantics: advance configured cartridge frames, then publish exactly one presentation frame
emulatorRuntime.livePath: worker-framebuffer -> persistent MRF1 stream -> FFmpeg -> WebRTC
emulatorRuntime.diagnosticIsolation: policy, JSON serialization, compression, and filesystem writes run outside the emulator worker

advisors.scope: routes, local motion, and collision-aware reachability
legal battle choices, risk, and expected outcomes

retainedLocomotion.routePlan: before input, the collision-aware pathfinder chooses the complete route and serializes its first straight segment as direction, tile count, and exact current-map endpoint
retainedLocomotion.command: B plus one direction remains continuously held across the preplanned straight running segment
retainedLocomotion.ordinaryTileTransition: the worker reads the cartridge coordinate after every emulated frame, keeps the chord down across intermediate tiles, releases at the exact waypoint, and waits for tileTransitionState zero
retainedLocomotion.precisionApproach: a turn starts a newly planned segment; doors, objects, field obstacles, and interactions use walking or bounded edges after running ends on their approach tile
retainedLocomotion.fallback: missing or inconsistent segment metadata degrades to a one-tile semantic movement lease
retainedLocomotion.blockedAttempt: release after sixty stationary cartridge frames or the route-sized absolute frame budget
retainedLocomotion.stableHeldInput: treat any input still held after the semantic lease settles as a verifier contradiction

controlWorkflows.purpose: retain a rectified objective across cartridge-owned multi-menu transitions

battlePartySelection.completion: the target party slot and species are observed as the active battler
invalidation: party workflow returned to the action menu without its postcondition
battlePartySelection.resumeRecovery: an orphaned non-item battle party picker selects a healthy non-active reserve and creates a normal transaction

diagnostics.journal: one independently compressed event for every decision, bot controller frame plan, and manual control handoff

manualRecoveryExamples.demonstration: frame-stamped button choices paired with lightweight cartridge state
manualRecoveryExamples.outcome: fresh post-intervention observation and first replanned bot decision
manualRecoveryExamples.provenance: causal journal plus pre/post replay bundles
manualRecoveryExamples.use: reviewed policy repair, regression evaluation, or future imitation training

invariants: Only the worker control gate may write cartridge input, and it accepts exactly one active owner.
Manual mode interrupts bot input, runs at 1x, and records every button-state choice with cartridge context.
Bot mode resumes only after a fresh atomic observation clears stale central workflow state.
Only the autonomous emulator worker may advance cartridge frames or publish framebuffers.
The central player has no direct cartridge session or step method.
Controller hold and release durations are measured in emulated cartridge frames.
Advisors receive immutable observations and return serializable advice only.
No observation carries owner, lease, controller, or input-writer state.
Map and modal transitions are recoverable interrupts, not ownership faults.
No action continues past an interrupt without a new central decision.
Observed cartridge state outranks policy assumptions.
A multi-menu objective remains a central workflow until its observed postcondition or invalidation.
Every bot command and manual control handoff is represented in the private causal journal.
Every completed manual intervention appends a replay-backed recovery example to the stable run dataset.
A recovery example never mutates live policy until a reviewed repair is implemented and regression-tested.
